---
title: "Creating Custom Iterators"
---

# Creating Custom Iterators
```rust
struct Counter {
    count: usize,
}

impl Counter {
    fn new() -> Self { Self { count: 0 } }
}

impl Iterator for Counter {
    type Item = usize;
    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<Self::Item> {
        if self.count < 3 {
            self.count += 1;
            Some(self.count)
        } else {
            None
        }
    }
}

fn main() {
    let counter = Counter::new();
    let items: Vec<usize> = counter.collect();
    println!("Custom iterator output: {:?}", items);
}
```
